question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. ' Have said'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "must have said" **is the correct form to fill in the blank.
 
• The sentence suggests that thousands of persons have said the same thing to her **since a particular point in time.**
 
• The use of the past participle** "said" in combination with "must have" **indicates that it is something that has happened in the past.
 
• This option provides the correct tense and matches the context of the passage.

Therefore the** correct sentence** is:- '*Thousands of persons must** have said** the same thing to her since'*
